title: Digits of a number in a base
description: Return Ok with the number of digits that n has when written in the given base (2 or more), without leading zeros. The number 0 is written with one digit. Check the input and return Err with exactly these messages: 'negative number' if n is below 0 (checked first), otherwise 'base must be at least 2' if base is below 2.
notes: Zero has one digit. Boundaries at exact powers of the base (255/256 in base 2 and 16, 99/100 in base 100). Error precedence is tested with both inputs bad. Division only happens on non-negative values, after the checks.
